children: Early design insights from One Click LCA helped AECOM show lower-carbon options before detailed plans were ready.

MONTREAL, Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The City of Montréal launched a project to redevelop a major transportation corridor and surrounding district with a clear vision: create a low carbon, climate-resilient neighborhood. The City needed to
compare early design concepts before detailed designs were available
was tasked with providing whole-life carbon insights to support climate-aligned decisions, and used
to estimate material quantities from early models, rapidly test scenarios, and assess impact in one streamlined workflow.
"One Click LCA played a pivotal role in this project by providing insights early in the process."  -J. Lagneau, AECOM

"One Click LCA played a pivotal role in this project by providing actionable insights early in the design process. Using Carbon Designer 3D alongside other tools, we modeled life cycle greenhouse gas emissions for major components across the production, construction, use, and end-of-life phases."
-Jérémy Lagneau, ESG and Decarbonization Advisor, AECOM
When the project was in the pre-design phase, AECOM integrated One Click LCA directly into its ScopeX™ decarbonization workflow. Scenario modeling showed that
subtle design decisions, like adjusting roadway width or optimizing overpass structural configuration, yielded meaningful carbon reductions
All project details are included in One Click LCA's new video case study, accessible here.

One Click LCA is the world's largest life cycle assessment (LCA) platform, delivering impact, compliance, and growth in +170 countries. It brings together the in-depth modelling capabilities of SimaPro with the ease-of-use and scalability of One Click LCA. The platform includes the most comprehensive global LCA database, with +500,000 datasets, and serves customers across manufacturing, construction, infrastructure, chemicals, and consumer goods supply chains, among others.
